messages:
Maya - CSM: Quick weekly health check for Velaris — noticed a hosted spend jump this billing window, tagging thread. Commit = $12,000/mo; current projection if trend holds = ~$18k/mo. Need quick triage on spend vs commit and any anomaly flags.

Jon - Renewals: Yikes. Any idea if this is a single customer change or multiple API keys? link to billing dashboard?

Maya - CSM: One API key (velaris-prod) is responsible for ~74% of the delta. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customer/velaris/billing (internal). Top-line: generation endpoints token rate up ~2.4x last 7d, embeddings up ~1.8x. 5xx rate baseline 0.6% -> 1.4% this week. Median latency moved 140ms -> 210ms.

Aisha - CS Ops: Flagging as `billing:potential-overage` and `ops:latency-rise`. Per runbook, if projected monthly > commit*1.2 then send renewal outreach + consider temporary credit.

Ian - SRE: Looking at request logs now. Early signal: several retries that look like fallback loops to a cheaper variant during peak. Will check if retries multiplied tokens due to replays. Quick grep I ran: ```rg "velaris-prod" /var/log/redwood/requests-2026-03-19.log | head``` returned multiple repeated req IDs.

BillingBot: [ALERT] Velaris exceeded 20% of committed monthly spend threshold at 2026-03-19T11:04:12Z. Trigger: commit=12000, projected_monthly=18100. Auto-flagged tags: billing/over-20p, cs-action-required.

Jon - Renewals: Can we confirm whether Velaris has burst enabled? If yes, options: (1) suggest upgrade to higher commit, (2) recommend Dedicated for stable high-volume, (3) temporary one-off credit while we root cause. I'll prep customer-facing notes.

Maya - CSM: They do have hosted burst enabled (confirmed in account settings). Also they pushed a dataset update yesterday — likely explains embeddings bump. I emailed PM asking whether any inference batch jobs kicked off.

Aisha - CS Ops: Suggested immediate steps: 1) Limit burst for velaris-prod to 2x baseline for 24h (prevents runaway), 2) add billing tag and notify finance, 3) schedule 30m sync with customer + AM to review commit options. Runbook snippet I'll paste: ```if projected_monthly > commit*1.2 then escalate to renewals + offer tiered commit options; if spike source = embeddings batch, recommend rate-limiting + batching optimizations```

Ian - SRE: On the infra side I'll patch fallback policy to avoid replaying tokens on failures (small config tweak). Also will check KV cache hit rates; if cache warmed incorrectly that could increase token generation.

Maya - CSM: I'll book a sync for tomorrow EOD with Velaris and include Jon + Aisha. Action items: Ian to post follow-up on logs, Aisha to open finance ticket, Jon to draft renewal options.

Jon - Renewals: I'll draft options and a short slide for the call: cost delta, commit uplift tiers, Dedicated sizing ballpark, and a recommended timeline.

Ian - SRE: Follow-up: found 3 high-frequency clients within velaris-prod that were re-playing requests after 503s. Root cause appears to be a retry loop in their client lib + our fallback variant. I'll send a short note and suggest a mitigation patch.

Maya - CSM: Great. Please post any logs/snippets here. I'll include the incident notes in the weekly health report. Thanks all :thumbsup:
